mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% for three consecutive months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers concerns about labor market weakness, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative within 5 trading days of UNRATE crossing above 5.0%, or the signal reverses direction before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and a decline in INDPRO (supply) indicate weakening supply-side constraints, amplifying growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The GDPC1-INDPRO interaction does not hold consistently over the horizon, or the 20-day returns are not statistically significantly different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained monthly declines in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% for three months signal accommodative monetary policy, enhancing equity risk-taking and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime shifts out of 'late-cycle expansion', or FEDFUNDS do not sustain the decline, resulting in non-positive returns over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in PAYEMS (labor employment) above 142,654 for three consecutive months reflects a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth does not persist for three months, or the 5-day returns fail to outperform a 5-day baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in INDPRO above 107.0 for three consecutive months signals robust industrial production and economic momentum, fostering optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain the monthly surge for three months, or the 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (employment) above their 1-month averages signals strong economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or PAYEMS growth fails to meet the 1-month average threshold, or the 5-day returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment environment (UNRATE < 4.0%), sustained monthly declines in UNRATE below 4.0% for three months reinforce labor market strength, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 4.0% during the regime period, or the 60-day returns are not significantly positive compared to a low-unemployment baseline (p > 0.05).
